nodes.title: round 5 phone-echo harness (evals/duplex-2026-10/assemble.mjs variant 'owner', SIMULATED): the owner's Android loudspeaker as the phone-speaker path (300 Hz-5 kHz, soft clip, 60 ms delay, 120 ms room tail, -6 dB under the child) behind a WEAK device AEC: full echo for the first 500 ms of each of her lines (re-converging), then 10 dB ERLE [E]. Over 102 of her lines (66 TaxilaFDB TEST + 36 continuer scenarios) it reproduces the owner's failure on the old D4 engine: phantom child transcripts of her voice on 65/66 lines, echo yields 48/66, her own voice hushing her on 66/66 (r5-gate.mjs). Not a phone: real-device validation is the owner's recorder.

D5 on the owner harness (evals/duplex-2026-10/arms-d5.mjs: the shipped relay to Voice Live centralindia + the shipped DuplexLive D5 path, real time, TTS children; arm d5r5c): over 102 of her lines 0 phantom child transcripts, 0 phantom turns, 0 echo yields; barge-in noticed 12/12 with her stop (hush -26 dB or pause/stop) <= 500 ms on 11/12 (p50 59 ms, p90 247 ms) via the pitch-gated pre-duck; continuer false yields 0/46; thinking-pause cut-offs 0/34. Echo hushes (a pre-duck on her own echo) 6/102 at 6 dB / 40 ms; retuned OFFLINE to 12 dB / 80 ms (evals/duplex-2026-10/preduck-tune.mjs, IN-SAMPLE, same 102 lines): 0/102 owner, 0/102 phone, 1/102 clean, barge pre-duck <= 500 ms 11/12 on each. NOT MET: end-of-turn p50 1,480 ms (bar 900): closed answers p50 1,500 because Voice Live returned an EMPTY transcript for 5/14 short closed answers on this audio (the turn then ends on the re-ask backstop), open explanations p50 3,030 ms by design (teach-back patience; cut-offs 0/34).

D4 half-duplex on the owner harness (arms-ours.mjs --half, real gpt-live-transcribe, arm d4h2) vs the old full-duplex D4 (d4full): phantom child transcripts 0/102 vs 65/66, phantom turns 0/102 vs 2/66, echo yields 0/102 vs 48/66, her voice hushed by her echo 0/102 vs 66/66; continuer false yields 0/46; barge-in 0/12 by design (no barge-in on the half-duplex lane); end-of-turn p50 1,560 ms, missed 3/34 (2 are hold_long by design); lone words noticed 1/8 (an empty turn is never committed on D4, so an unheard 'haan' waits for her silence nudge).

D4 (the fallback lane when D5 cannot open, and the live lane without D5) runs HALF-DUPLEX: while her line plays, her output is audible, or within the tail after either (250 ms + AudioContext.outputLatency within 400-900 ms, else 600), the mic track is disabled, the engine reads the room's quiet level, and any transcription item that starts in that window is dropped whole; micro-commits only for audio the transcriber holds (no commit_empty); an empty turn is never committed on D4. ?duplexfull=1 keeps the full engine on a device. Merged with main's release-14 implementation (337b09a). Reverse if: the owner's real-phone recorder shows a child's answer lost inside the tail more than 1 in 20 turns, or the device AEC is shown sufficient on the cohort's phones (then full-duplex D4 for headsets only).

One turn at a time on every lane: no engine turn while an engine-committed turn or a tapped / typed answer is waiting for her reply (cleared when her reply starts; a lost reply stops holding after 15 s), none within 3 s of a tap, and the link drops a spoken final within 3 s of a tap until her reply to it arrives. The safety floor (safeguard / safety cut-in) is never held. Reverse if: real sessions show a child's spoken correction right after a tap lost more than 1 in 20 times.

D5 pre-duck ON by default, straight to the hush level (-26 dB), only for a burst 12 dB above her predicted echo for 80 ms with a pitch >= 1.5 semitones from her own output pitch and its octaves (her echo carries her pitch; measured: 4,448 echo frames at 0 st, ~30 at each of +-12). Voice Live silence 250 ms (decide-late in the engine). No text echo subtraction on D5 (the ear removed her echo acoustically; subtracting her words deleted a child's 'आठ corners'). Reverse if: the owner's recorder shows false pre-ducks on her own echo on more than 2 % of her lines, or barge-in pre-duck <= 500 ms falls below 80 % on real children.

Voice Live's azure-speech (hi-IN,en-IN) returns EMPTY transcripts for some short child answers on the owner harness (5/14 closed answers: 'सात है ना', 'तीस दीदी', 'छह faces दीदी', 'चालीस square cm', 'हाँ'); hi-IN alone recovers some ('40', 'साथ है ना') but drops English words ('आठ corners'). This is what holds end-of-turn p50 at ~1.5 s for closed answers on D5. Next: gpt-4o-transcribe inside Voice Live, or a second ear for short bursts (the device-side clip to /api/voice/transcribe).

D5 on the owner harness AFTER the 8 confirmed D5 review fixes (arm d5r8, same method and 102 of her lines as d5r5c, pre-duck 12 dB / 80 ms now LIVE, not offline): 0/102 phantom child transcripts, 0/102 phantom turns, 0/102 echo yields, 0/102 echo hushes (was 6/102 at 6 dB / 40 ms: the offline retune holds live); barge-in noticed 12/12, her stop <= 500 ms 11/12 (p50 80 ms, p90 425 ms); continuer false yields 0/46; end-of-turn p50 1,480 ms (NOT MET, bar 900), p90 3,620; missed 3/34 (was 2: f1-0033, a lone haan Voice Live opened no item for, is now correctly NOT turned into an empty turn — review #6 — so the child is not heard; before, an injected empty final made it a re-ask); thinking-pause cut-offs 1/34 (f2-cue_maths-0180: Voice Live run-to-run variance closed item 2 at 8,960 instead of 9,560 ms, inside the child pause, with a question-shaped text; committed, revoked 500 ms later when the child went on, her words merged; not caused by the fixes, which touch only no-text turns). Lone words noticed 5/8 (was 6/8, the same f1-0033).

D5 posts an empty child turn ONLY when Voice Live itself opened an item and returned an empty or failed final over the burst (the ear covered it). A burst only the device heard (her echo through a weak device AEC, a door, a cough Voice Live ignored) never becomes a turn: after the ear's slowest final it returns the floor unspoken. Cost: a lone haan Voice Live never opens an item for is unheard (1/34 after-her turns on the owner harness). Reversal: if owner-cohort recordings show real children unheard this way more than 1 in 20 closed answers AND their device bursts are distinguishable from echo (pitch / level vs her output), re-admit those bursts as re-asks.

D5 end-of-turn steps on the owner harness (evals/duplex-2026-10/arms-d5.mjs, eot-replay.mjs; 34 after-her turns, 102 of her lines). Method: a live baseline that records Voice Live audio times (d5r11), REPLAYED through the old code (rpB: identical to live on every bar, so the replay is faithful) and the new code (rpA, steps 1+2), then a live run with Voice Live silence 200 (d5v200, step 3) on the same scenarios. EOT p50: 1,500 (rpB) → 1,130 (steps 1+2) → 1,100 (step 3); closed answers (F1) 1,480 → 1,100 → 920; p90 3,620 → 3,620 → 3,400. Main's conditions, every arm: turns whose child words went on after the first commit 10/34 in rpB = 10/34 rpA = 10/34 d5v200 (the same pre-existing turns: F5 word-search / hold scenarios and two self-repairs; none new); first-commit value changed 3 = 3 = 3 (same turns, none new); thinking-pause cut-offs 1/34 = 1/34 = 1/34; re-asks 5 / 5 / 4, re-asks with child speech starting within 600 ms 0 (NOTE: the bake children do not speak after their answer, so this count cannot fail here; it needs the owner cohort recordings). Unchanged in every arm: phantom transcripts 0/102, phantom turns 0/102, echo yields 0/102, echo hushes 0/102, barge-in 12/12, stop <=500 ms 11/12 (p50 80), continuer false yields 0/46, missed 3/34, lone words 5/8. Anatomy (d5v200): only 6 of 34 turns <= 900 ms: the ear floor is ~730 ms (Voice Live speech_stopped ≈ 200 ms silence + ~460 ms event latency, final +60-80 ms, no partials from azure-speech); empties re-ask ~1,100 (final + 300); word-search and short explanations wait ~1,080 by design; open explanations ~3.0 s by design (12/34). Verdict: the 900 ms p50 bar is NOT reachable on lane D5 with this ear without cutting the designed patience (word search, teach-back) or re-asking on top of the child.

D5 closed answers commit at Voice Live's covering final when it carries a value (D5_CLOSED_AT_FINAL_MS 600 floor; never over a hold stretch or the child's own pace); an empty final re-asks 300 ms after it (D5_EMPTY_FINAL_REASK_MS); Voice Live silence 250 → 200 (D5_SERVER_VAD_MS). Measured: ms-r5-d5-eot-steps-2026-10-15. Reversal: owner-cohort recordings show a self-correction cut, a changed value, or a re-ask with the child starting within 600 ms, at a rate above the pre-change engine on the same recordings.

EOT step 4, MAI-Transcribe inside Voice Live (centralindia, api 2026-07-15), small n. Session probe: every MAI model refuses two locales ("MAI Transcribe supports at most one locale": the earlier trials hung in their retries on this, not a timeout of the model); mai-transcribe-2-streaming is "not supported in this region" (centralindia), so no partials are available; mai-transcribe-2 opens with no locale (multilingual) or hi-IN. Owner variant, 5 closed answers (3 where azure-speech returned EMPTY), Voice Live silence 200, same audio: mai-transcribe-2 returned words on all 3 empties ("तीस दीदी" right, value 30; "सात है ना" → "साथ है ना" and "छह faces दीदी" → "Chair faces DD": the value lost), and its finals land 250-410 ms LATER than azure-speech (speech_stopped the same ±45 ms). For end of turn that is worse: every closed answer +~300 ms, and 2 of 3 recovered empties still carry no value. Not adopted for EOT; noted for comprehension recall (fewer empty turns) if the value misreads can be handled.

MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming (southindia account taxila-ai-southindia; Microsoft first-party, sold direct by Azure) as Voice Live's in-session ASR. It is offered by Voice Live in southindia (not centralindia); locale none (multilingual) or a 2-letter code ("hi"), never "hi-IN". Owner variant, Voice Live silence 200, gpt-4.1-mini session, the same 10 closed answers (n=10, small by capacity 10), azure-speech in the same region as control: final after Voice Live speech_stopped p50 53 ms (MAI) vs 254 ms (azure-speech); empty finals 0/10 vs 3/10; partial deltas 0 vs 0 (no partials from either, so no decide-before-speech_stopped). Values right 7/10 vs 7/10, but MAI read one value WRONG ("पंद्रह सेंटीमीटर" → "100 cm."; azure-speech "15 सेंटीमीटर") and lost two ("सात"→"साथ", "छह"→"Chair") where azure-speech returned empty. A wrong value is a truth risk (a verdict on a value the child never said), an empty is a re-ask: not adopted at this n; deciding number = the wrong-value rate at n >= 40 per ASR.

The measured end-of-turn FLOOR on lane D5 (main accepted 2026-10-15: 1,100 ms is the number we report; 900 is not reachable with this ear). Anatomy, owner harness d5v200, 34 after-her turns: ear floor ~730 ms (Voice Live speech_stopped ≈ 200 ms silence + ~460 ms event latency, final +60-80 ms, no partials) → fastest commits 730-750; empty finals re-ask at ~1,100 (final + 300); word search and short explanations ~1,080 (designed patience); open explanations ~3.0 s by design (12/34). EOT p50 1,100, p90 3,400; closed answers 920.

Round 5 truth bar, self-repair stress set (evals/duplex-2026-10/stretch-repair.mjs: the 5 self-repair scenarios, repair pause 1.5/2.0/2.5/3.0 s = 20 turns, live Voice Live owner variant, code 7ec0cdc6). The engine commits the wrong value ~760 ms after it ends (730-860) and the child's correction revokes it 10-90 ms after its onset (20/20). With R = commit → her first audible word, a verdict on the abandoned value is heard (no hold) in 15/10/5/0 of 20 at R = 1.0/1.5/2.0/2.7 s; with the verdict hold (VERDICT_HOLD_MS 2,500 after the value end) 5/5/5/0, the 5 being exactly the 3.0 s pauses (beyond the hold). Cost of the hold (first-sound delay, 10 closed-value turns of the bake set, d5v200 commits): R 1.0 s p50 700 / max 780 ms (8/10 delayed); 1.5 s p50 200 / max 280 (8/10); 2.0 s and 2.7 s 0 (0/10). Condition 2 (the revoked turn must not land on the server as its own graded turn) is NOT covered by the hold: with the turn response at commit + R − 0.6 s, the turn lands before the correction in 20/15/10/5 of 20 at R = 1.0/1.5/2.0/2.7 s; an outbox edit after landing replays (editLanded) instead of superseding.

Her reply to a closed answer carrying a value never SOUNDS before the value's end + 2,500 ms (VERDICT_HOLD_MS; the engine's G7 stamp + 500, carried on the commit as verdictHoldUntil, enforced by CascadeLink on both the promptTeacher and early-audio paths by holding the stream's hand-over; the speech request still goes out at once; the ack clip is not held; a correction during the hold revokes and stops the reply). Main 2026-10-15, G = 2,500. Measured: ms-r5-truth-bar-stress-2026-10-15. Reversal: if the measured first-sound cost at the then-current R exceeds ~250 ms on closed-value turns, revisit G with data.

REJECTED claim (4B, 2026-10-15): "her verdict cannot sound before value end + VERDICT.delayMs" was cited as the protection against a verdict on an abandoned value. The gate was computed (governor G7 verdictNotBefore) and emitted on the speak command but NOTHING enforced it (live.ts / cascadeDuplex / the link never read it). Lesson: a computed gate is not a protection until a test shows the sound waiting for it. Now enforced: dc-r5-verdict-hold-2500.

Before building the edit full undo (main's two pre-build measurements). (1) How often a correction can land after the turn: the sim lab's voice lane has no commit timing (whole utterances through the batch transcriber), so the situation was counted instead — 300 voice lessons, 1,605 child answers carrying a value: 7.2% (116) self-repair INSIDE the utterance (text lane 11.7%); 3.2% correct at the start of the next turn (those arrive after her reply anyway: not the supersede case). The only timed gold repair pauses (TaxilaFDB, n=5) are 0.46-1.65 s; at today's R (~2.7 s; the turn lands ≈ commit + 2.1 s, the commit ≈ 0.76 s after the value) a repair must pause > ~2.9 s to land after the turn (0/5); at R = 1.5 s the threshold falls to ~1.7 s, at R = 1.0 s to ~1.2 s. Rare today; grows as replies get faster. (2) lesson_undo cost on the stream's Neon branch, 40 real lessons with ≥ 20 turns: lesson.state p50 14.5 KB / p95 18.6 KB / max 23 KB (n=200 long lessons); one turn's state write vs the same plus the lesson_undo upsert in the same transaction, n=240 each, two interleaved runs: p50 43.1 → 47.1 ms (+4), p95 52.8 → 60.2 ms (+7.5) — under main's 20 ms bar (absolute numbers include the sandbox's RTT to Neon).

Edit full undo (server/brain/supersede.js, migration 030 allotted by main; behind TAXILA_EDIT_UNDO=1, off by default) on the TEST branch, no model call (tests/r5-edit-supersede-db.run.mjs, 6/6): landed then edit → one grade, the edit's, first-try correct (the abandoned attempt is out of the episode), the original's verdict in evidence_superseded, its transcript row labelled, its trace row archived; right → wrong → graded on the ORIGINAL item, the right answer's kt event moved to kt_evidence_superseded; a second edit → replay; a blind verdict for a superseded event → dropped (fails without the guard; the same verdict for a live event is applied: control); the cached kt_skill_state equals a fresh fold of the live kt_evidence after EVERY edit in a run of three; an edit after a later turn landed → replay + turn.edit_missed. Also found and fixed: loadLive's per-process fold only read rows after its seq, so a supersede on ANOTHER replica would have been folded back in; it now keeps the cache only while the count of rows up to its seq is unchanged. Main's rule (6), MOVE never flag, extended to grade_audit / probe_log / weave_queue: the turn's inserts record their ids in its lesson_undo row (with ins as (insert … returning id) update lesson_undo); the edit moves them to *_superseded. Census test: after an edit, each of the six *_superseded tables holds exactly the original's rows and none of them is still live; an earlier turn's rows are untouched. pending_grade: a verdict for an event of a superseded turn is not written (liveness predicate in the insert) and the lesson's trace row gains turn.verdict_dropped. Found while wiring: the archives (child data) were unclassified for the M0 ratchet (ratchetPlan refuses an unclassified child_id table) and had no foreign keys (a deleted child left them behind); now kt_* archives are layer kt, the comprehension ones M0 history, each with the original's cascade FK.

Verdict hold (G=2500, dc-r5-verdict-hold-2500) first-sound cost at today's R, main's 14.4 gate (evals/duplex-2026-10/hold-cost.mjs, results/hold-cost.json). Ear: live Voice Live D5 on the owner recordings, the 17 closed-answer scenarios that are not self-repair, 4 live passes = 76 commits, 20 carrying a hold. R: the same committed words as a real turn (Azure models, the stream's TEST DB, kit item posed) → /api/lesson/turn + tts-stream first byte + 60 ms lead + 50 ms nominal output (no turn-audio fold: off by default). R on the 20 held-candidate turns p50 3,076 / p90 6,164 ms (all 76: 4,261 / 7,790; from the sandbox, Neon over HTTP: likely slower than production; a faster R costs more, so read the curve). Hold deadline after commit (gap) p50 1,980 / p90 2,060 / max 2,080 ms (2 hold_long turns: negative, the deadline had passed at commit). Added first sound: p50 0 / p90 0 / max 104 ms; held 1 of 20. Curve on the same gaps if R were faster: R 1.0 s → +980/+1,060 (p50/p90); 1.25 → +730/+810; 1.5 → +480/+560; 1.75 → +230/+310; 2.0 → 0/+60; ≥ 2.25 → 0. Under the 250 ms bar at today's R; crosses it near R ≈ 1.7 s — the reversal condition to watch with the latency work.

How often a correction lands after its turn on the live D5 lane at today's R (main's 14.5 measurement before the full undo is switched on; evals/duplex-2026-10/late-edit.mjs, results/late-edit-natural.json + late-edit-stretched.json). Method: live Voice Live D5 on the owner recordings; each commit's revoked words recorded (evals/duplex-real/lib.mjs), so a merged commit carrying revokeOf = an EDIT of the first commit's turn; late = edit time − first commit > L (commit → the turn landed). NATURAL self-repairs, 5 scenarios × 4 live passes = 20 runs (identical per scenario): repair pause 0.46 / 0.62 / 0.64 s → kept inside the utterance (12/12, no edit); 1.48 / 1.65 s → committed first, edit 6.3-7.6 s later (the corrected value was misheard, the engine waited out its backstop) → late at EVERY L (8/8; the child's correction itself ended 2.2-3.5 s after the commit, so even an instant ear is late at L ≤ 2.1 s). STRETCHED pauses 1.5-3.0 s, 20 runs: 20/20 commit first then edit, 3.2-8.9 s later; late 20/20 at L ≤ 2.7 s, 18/20 at 3.5 s. So: a repair pause ≥ ~1.5 s (threshold between 0.64 and 1.48 s, not resolved) always lands its correction after the turn; shorter ones never need an edit. Per self-repair: 2 of 5 natural owner repairs (Wilson 95% 12-77%). Per valued voice answer: × the sim lab's 7.2% self-repair rate (n=1,605, simulated) ≈ 2.9% (≈ 0.9-5.5%) — NOT rare, but n=5 adult-imitated repairs; real children's pause distribution is the open number. Corrects ms-r5-edit-supersede-size-cost's "> ~2.9 s pause" estimate: it timed the correction from the value's end, but the edit goes when the CORRECTION ends plus the ear's end of turn. Production: 77aa2e4d writes turn.edit_after_landed / turn.edit_missed / turn.edited with the undo OFF, so once deployed the owner's D5 lessons give the real rate (count ÷ voice-lane turns with a value); the stream cannot read production.
